I will do this plot mostly the way I know, because cash is tight and I do not want to risk buying many things. On my maize field I will put manure from home and only a little chemical fertilizer if I can get it, because many people here use some fertilizer on maize, but I cannot manage a full bag on this small piece. I will keep local seed that I trust, I will not buy spray, and I will depend on the rains.
